name: Standard Capital Markets Limited
about: Standard Capital Markets Limited operates as a non-banking financial company in India. The company offers personal, syndicated, and working capital loans. It also provides financial services, such as lending of money to individuals and small and medium sized enterprises with or without security; dealing in securities/shares of companies; and bonds and units investment in stock markets. In addition, the company manufactures and trades in brooms. Standard Capital Markets Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is based in New Delhi, India.
